name: Honduras Digital Challenge 2020: COVID-19
content: Problems and Purpose The “Honduras Digital Challenge 2020: COVID-19” hackathon enables participants to collaboratively seek solutions and technological proposals to address impacts from the COVID-19 pandemic. This initiative is aimed at engaging citizens with programming skills working in any of the following areas: web development, mobile development, data science, and systems architecture. Interested citizens can also register as mentors and provide financial or material support for programmers.
